extraction_notes: Titled 'תוצאות סקר 27.8'. PDF does not name the pollster or commissioner; taken from CEC metadata (טאטיקה מחקרים ומדיה for זמן ישראל). Fieldwork 26/8 12:00 to 27/8 15:00 (year 2026). Method: internet panel + phone completions ('פאנל אינטרנטי + השלמות טלפוניות'). Initial sample: 9,000 SMS with link + 72 phone calls = 9,072; 519 answered, 19 excluded as unfit/out of quota -> 500 respondents. Response rate recorded as 7.0 derived from the stated 93% non-response. Population not explicitly stated (CEC requested completions); demographic tables show Jews and Arabs, 18+. Margin of error 4.4%.
